[[File:TravelingCaldera.png|thumb|''The '''Traveling Merchant''' at {{Caldera Island}}''|331x331px]]

The '''Traveling Merchant''' is a [[shopkeepers|Shopkeeper]] [[NPCs|NPC]] that spawns randomly around the world.  
The Merchant is always active, and his stock refreshes every day.
The Merchant sells powerful and exclusive items, with trades available for either money or {{Meteor Shards|meteor shards}}.  
Unless they refresh the Merchant's stock (for Robux), each player sees the '''same set of items''' (globally), and purchases are client-sided.

== Locations ==
The Merchant can appear at multiple preset locations.  

* {{Azuralite Oasis}} - in the back right corner
* {{Caldera Park}} - two locations:
** Next to the [[Shard Merchant]]
** Between the {{Volcanic Springs}} hill and the entrance to {{Magma Furnace}}
* {{Fortune River}} - two locations:
** On the riverbank, upstream from the dock
** In the park between the town and Sunset Beach
* {{Fortune River Delta}} - on the next island over from the waypoint, a bit upstream
* {{Sunset Beach}} - near the rocks that separate the waypoint and lighthouse from the beach

== Dialogue ==
(Note that it is not necessary to talk to the Merchant to purchase the items he has in stock.)
{{Dialogue Start}}
: ''Traveling Merchant'': Have a look, Prospector! You won't find these anywhere else!
: {{Choice|Restock [R$(regionally-adjusted price)]}}
: {{Choice|What can you sell? [?]}}
:: (Displays the Merchant Stock Info list, see below)
: {{Choice|Sure!}}
:: ''Traveling Merchant'': I move around and change my stock every day! Come back tomorrow for new items!
{{Dialogue End}}

== Notes ==
* The Traveling Merchant’s inventory '''resets each spawn'''.  
* Announcements appear above the hotbar when they spawn, revealing the location.

* '''Fun Fact:''' When the Traveling Merchant spawns on Caldera Island Volcano, it is referring to the spawn spot near the waypoint. When it spawns on Caldera Island ''only'', it is referring to the spawn spot at the foot of the volcano. -->
